subject: math

objective.text: Fold a clock into halves and quarters. Tell time to the half hour and quarter hour.

source_ref.section: Lesson objective: Construct a paper clock by partitioning a circle into halves and quarters, and tell time to the half hour or quarter hour.

explanations.title: Half past
explanations.text: The minute hand goes halfway around. It points to the 6. Half an hour has passed. We say half past.

explanations.title: Quarters of an hour
explanations.text: Fold the clock in half, then in half again. Now there are 4 quarters. Each quarter is 15 minutes.

explanations.title: Quarter past and quarter to
explanations.text: Minute hand on the 3 means a quarter past the hour. On the 9, it means a quarter to the next hour.

explanations.title: Count by fives
explanations.text: There are 5 minutes from one number to the next. Count 5, 10, 15 to reach the 3.

examples.title: A quarter to two
examples.text: The clock shows 1:45. The minute hand is on the 9. One quarter is left until 2. So it is a quarter to two.

Count the quarters the minute hand has passed.

misconceptions.label: Confusing 'a quarter to' the hour
misconceptions.description: Child hears 'a quarter to two' and places the time near 2:00 or after 2, instead of 1:45.
detection_signals: Says 'a quarter to two' is 2:15 or 2:45.
Writes the hour as 2 for 'a quarter to two'.
misconceptions.response_text: A quarter to two means 1 quarter hour before 2. That is 1:45. The hour hand is still before the 2.

source_ref.section: Concept Development Part 4: 'some students may be confused by the language to two'

assets_required.why_this_method: Hand positions must be exact, and the hour hand must move partway between numbers. Diffusion cannot do this.
assets_required.description: An analog clock with numbers 1-12, minute marks, an hour hand and a minute hand. Can also show a digital readout.
must_show_exactly: Numbers 1-12 in correct positions, 60 minute marks
Minute hand points exactly at the stimulus minute
Hour hand sits between hours in proportion to the minutes (for example halfway between 3 and 4 at 3:30)
Quarter marks: 12, 3, 6, 9 drawn bold; 15, 30, 45, 60 written outside
q_pr_10: 1:45 with the hour hand three quarters of the way from 1 to 2
states_or_frames: any time hh:mm from the stimulus
assets_required.interaction: Display, or the child drags the hands. The tutor sets the time from the question stimulus.
assets_required.alt_text: A clock face with an hour hand and a minute hand.

assets_required.why_this_method: Folds must split the circle into exactly 2, then 4 equal parts.

must_show_exactly: Fold 1: 2 equal halves, 12 at top, 6 at bottom
states_or_frames: frame 3: opened, line traced, 12 and 6 written
assets_required.interaction: Plays step by step on tap.
